title: Food poisoning at a charity auction
setting: Community centre auction. Out-of-date dairy product in homemade cake caused severe food poisoning. Patient gagging, about to vomit, severe stomach pain.
verdictExplanation: Severe food poisoning with intense pain, gagging, borderline low BP (88/59), and high risk of dehydration/airway blockage. Sick: 999.

history.history: Eaten a homemade cake with out-of-date dairy products 30 minutes ago

followUp.question: What is the correct first aid management for this patient?

options.text: Help the patient sit comfortably, provide a sick bag, encourage small sips of water if fully conscious, and seek medical advice
Force the patient to drink large quantities of salty water to induce further vomiting
Administer his regular dose of insulin to lower blood sugar
Lie him flat on his back and tell him to sleep

followUp.explanation: Management of food poisoning. Help the patient sit comfortably and provide a sick bag. Encourage small sips of water to prevent dehydration if fully conscious. Never force vomiting or administer prescription drugs. Never lay flat due to aspiration risk.

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Reassure, provide sick bag. Give sips of water. Monitor closely.
levelFlags.erNotes: Ensure BGL is monitored (risk of ketoacidosis in diabetic patients). Hydrate within scope, check vitals, and prepare for onward care if severe.
